errors.evidence: The x-axis categories are not ordered alphabetically. They are ordered sequentially based on the number of employees (company size), for example 'До 50' (Up to 50) is followed by 'До 250' (Up to 250), then '250-500'.

When describing the highest bars, the description mentions the bar for 'Над 5000' (15 participants) but omits that the bar for 'До 250' has the same height of 15 participants. This fails to describe the tie for the second-highest value.

The description uses the plural form 'най-ниските' (the lowest ones) but then provides only a single category. This is grammatically incorrect and awkward. The singular form 'най-ниският' should have been used as there is only one bar with the lowest value.
